text: 你们三人追赶伯纳德。由于他脚踝受伤，你们很快超过了他。身后的猿人闻到你们恐惧的气味，开始追赶。它们体型庞大，却行动迅速。你必须利用地形摆脱它们。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 624
text: The three of you bound after Bernard. Since he is hobbled, you quickly get ahead of him. The ape-men behind are incited by your scent of fear and run after you. Despite their size and bulk, they move swiftly. You will have to use the terrain against them.
